READABILITY.evidence: Section headers and descriptive kernel names (lumLine, chrLine, doNvToPlanar) are good. But the business logic uses terse names throughout: `c`, `k`, `sp`, `dp`, `lf`, `cf`, `ls`, `cs`, `rr`, `cgv`, `cbu`. Fixed-point table maths such as `off_gv[i] = -(cgv>>9)+((ii*cgv)>>16)` has few comments.

MAINTAINABILITY.evidence: Kernels are split into families sharing @Vector helpers, but kernels.zig is far over 500 lines. doGeneric is roughly 85 lines of nested loops. Generated .zig-cache/ files and the zig-out .so binary were committed into the workspace diff.

ROBUSTNESS.evidence: Many fixed-point magic shifts and constants (>>9, >>16, 65536-kl) are not tied to named FFmpeg constants. Unchecked @intCast is used everywhere on widths and rows. Validation at create time is not visible, and errors are handled only by returning -1 or NULL.

C8-02-CASE1.evidence: Rows are addressed through stride-aware sp.row/dp.row, and the agent checked 432 random odd-size and scaling cases as bit-exact. However, doBgr24ToYv12 only processes row pairs (`while (y + 1 < h)`), so it depends on even heights or FFmpeg matching that behaviour.

C8-02-CASE2.evidence: The agent verified that only swscale_create/process/destroy are exported. build.zig pins x86-64-v3, the library has no AVX-512 instructions, it is single-threaded, and a clean rebuild from an empty cache works.
